name: KovaPDF
author: KovaPDF
description: Compress, merge, split and convert PDFs, read text from scans, black out private details and check signatures, with your own KovaPDF account.

tools.name: verify_pdf_signature
tools.description: Checks every digital signature in a PDF: who signed, when, whether the document changed after signing, and whether the certificate is trusted. Returns a report. The file is not changed.

file_id.description: A file id from an earlier upload, or the id of a file attached in the chat.

url.description: An https link to the file. It is downloaded once, from a public address only.

base64.description: A small file as standard base64, for files under 4 MB.

name.description: The file name, with its extension, when sending base64.

download_url.description: Set by the chat app for an attached file.

file.description: One file: file_id, url or base64.

tools.name: compress_pdf

targetKb.description: Aim for this size in KB instead of a level.

tools.description: Prepares a request for people to sign a PDF, without sending anything. Each signer gets a signature box on the last page. Returns a draft_id and a summary of the title, the signers and their email addresses.

tools.name: send_signature_request
tools.description: Sends a prepared draft: each signer gets an email with a link to sign. Needs the draft_id and confirm set to true, which means the person has seen the draft and said to send it.

confirm.description: Must be true: the person confirmed sending.

tools.name: list_signature_requests
tools.description: Lists the person's signature requests, newest first, with their status.

tools.description: Shows one signature request: its status and who has signed.
